title: Degree reduction
statement: Given a resharer $R$ of degree $d$ and a finite set $A$ of parties, the degree-reduction map sends an assignment $u$ of field elements to parties to the assignment whose value at party $j$ is $\sum_{i\in A} \lambda_{A,i} R_i(u(i),j)$, where $\lambda_{A,i}$ is the recombination coefficient for $A$ and $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
